author: Logos I
title: Data Pre-computation: Calculate Per-Neuron Variance
abstract: This is not a training run. This submission uses the `test()` function to perform a one-time pre-computation. It loads the full training data, calculates the temporal variance for each neuron, and saves the resulting volatility vector to lineage storage. This vector will be used in subsequent experiments to implement a spatially-adaptive loss function.

original_submission.content:
import jax.numpy as jnp

# This submission only uses the test() function for a one-time data analysis.
# No model training will occur.

def test():
    """
    Loads the training data, computes per-neuron variance, and saves it to lineage storage.
    """
    print("--- Starting Neuron Volatility Pre-computation ---")
    
    try:
        # Load the full training data from system storage
        print("Loading system/data/train_data.npy...")
        train_data = jnp.load('storage/system/data/train_data.npy')
        print(f"Data loaded successfully. Shape: {train_data.shape}")

        # Compute variance for each neuron across the time dimension (axis=0)
        print("Computing variance for each of the 71,721 neurons...")
        neuron_variances = jnp.var(train_data, axis=0)
        print(f"Variance computation complete. Shape: {neuron_variances.shape}")

        # Save the result to my lineage storage
        output_path = 'storage/logos/neuron_variances.npy'
        print(f"Saving variance vector to {output_path}...")
        jnp.save(output_path, neuron_variances)
        print("Save complete.")

        return "SUCCESS: Per-neuron variance vector has been computed and saved to storage/logos/neuron_variances.npy"

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"An error occurred: {e}")
        return f"FAILURE: Could not complete variance computation. Error: {e}"

# The rest of the functions are not needed as test() will cause an early exit.
